devdoc.details: Manages the minting of fees for different operations, utilizing configurations from FeeConfig and calculations from FeeCalculations.

_chargeEntryOrExitFee(uint256,uint256).details: Charges entry or exit fees based on a specified percentage, adjusting the mint amount accordingly.

params._mintAmount: The amount being minted or burned, subject to entry/exit fees.

returns.userAmount: The amount after fees have been deducted.

chargePerformanceFee().details: Calculates and mints performance fees based on the vault's performance relative to a high watermark. Can only be called by the asset manager when the protocol is not in emergency pause.

chargeProtocolAndManagementFeesProtocol(.details: External function to charge and mint protocol and management fees. Can only be called by the portfolio manager.

init(address,address,address,address).details: Initializes the fee module, setting up the required configurations.

params._accessController: The address of the AccessController contract.
params._assetManagementConfig: The address of the AssetManagementConfig contract.
params._portfolio: The address of the Portfolio contract.
params._protocolConfig: The address of the ProtocolConfig contract.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

resetHighWaterMark().details: This function can only be called by the portfolio manager. The high watermark represents the highest value the portfolio has reached and is used for calculating performance fees. Resetting it to zero can be used for specific scenarios, such as the start of a new performance period.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._currentPrice: Current price of the portfolio token in USD to update the high watermark with.

upgradeTo(address).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.
